problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target value, return the index if the target is found. If not, return -1.

examples.explanation: 9 exists in nums and its index is 4

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4,-1,2,1] has the largest sum 6.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.description: Merge two sorted linked lists and return it as a new sorted list.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.
